response.text: Interesting: 1364's invoice isn't flagged (the invoice amount matches the credit side of 6883.61), and 5900 isn't used. Invoice 705 is mismatched by 27.00. Let me look at more detail.

arguments.sql: select i."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT", i."JRNL_NO", (select string_agg(trim("ACCT_CD")||':'||"DR_AMT"||'/'||"CR_AMT",' ; ') from "GLJRNL" l where l."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO") lines from "APINVH" i where i."INV_ID" in (705,802) or i."JRNL_NO" in (1364,2459,2194)

select upper(regexp_replace(trim("VEND_CD")||'|'||"INV_NO",'[^A-Za-z0-9|]','','g')) k, count(*), min("INV_ID"), max("INV_ID"), string_agg("INV_ID"::text||':'||"INV_NO"||':'||"INV_AMT",' ; ') from "APINVH" group by 1 having count(*)>1

select p."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT", i."STAT_CD", count(*) n, sum(p."PAY_AMT") paid, min(p."PAY_DT") mn, i."INV_DT" from "APPAYM" p join "APINVH" i using("INV_ID") group by p."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT", i."STAT_CD", i."INV_DT" having count(*)>1 or sum(p."PAY_AMT")<>i."INV_AMT" or min(p."PAY_DT")<i."INV_DT" or i."STAT_CD"<>'P'
select i."INV_ID", i."STAT_CD" from "APINVH" i where i."STAT_CD"='P' and not exists (select 1 from "APPAYM" p where p."INV_ID"=i."INV_ID")
